pets.name: Furball
pets.description: Fur-st come, fur-st served! The first Pet to detach from its dragon counterpart, Furball, has learned to thrive solo and inhabit your Islands. Of course, a Dragon Master's helping hand is always appreciated! This energetic, lovable friend enjoys belly rubs and rolling around like a furry tumbleweed!

pets.name: Kika
pets.description: Double the tails, double the fun! Kika is a loyal gray companion who’s always wagging her way into trouble. Whether she’s chasing her own shadows or fetching rare artifacts, this two-tailed pup is a blur of energy. She might be small, but her heart is big enough to lead any Dragon Master toward a new adventure!

pets.name: Lilly
pets.description: This pastel puff of joy loves hiding enchanted eggs and surprising her dragon friends with sweet springtime magic. With her tiny horn and bouncy energy, she’s the perfect little companion to brighten any Dragon Master’s easter adventure!

pets.name: Chirpy
pets.description: Don't let those tiny wings fool you, Chirpy's rainbow plumage means she's never hard to spot, and she wouldn't have it any other way. This cheerful little chick bounces through every island with a song in her beak and a streak of color in her wake. With a personality as bright as her feathers, she'll keep any Dragon Master's spirits soaring no matter the adventure!

pets.name: Gecko
pets.description: Gecko might not be the most beautiful or the cutest pet in the universe, but this has not stopped him from caring about his master in his own unique ways.

pets.name: Cranky
pets.description: With his trusty blue shell and big, sparkling green eyes, this little crustacean is anything but grumpy! Cranky might have a tough exterior, but he's a total softie who loves scuttling alongside his favorite Dragon Master, bringing a pinch of seaside charm to every adventure.

pets.name: Purrbell
pets.description: With his plush turquoise coat, swirling leaf-shaped tail, and huge glimmering eyes, this little kitten looks ready to pounce on adventure! Purrbell may seem like a bundle of energy, but he's a gentle soul at heart, happily trotting beside his favorite Dragon Master and sprinkling a bit of woodland wonder wherever he goes.

pets.name: Frogstein
pets.description: With his patchwork turquoise-and-gold hide, stitched-up seams, and mismatched glimmering eyes, this little frog looks freshly hopped out of a mad scientist's lab! Frogstein may seem like a spooky little experiment gone wrong, but he's a gentle soul at heart, happily hopping beside his favorite Dragon Master and sprinkling a bit of stitched-up charm wherever he goes.
